description:
Implement a tuning configuration framework for DataFrame adapters that parallels the
SQL tuning system. Unlike SQL adapters where tuning affects schema and table creation,
DataFrame tuning focuses on runtime execution parameters, memory management, and
parallelism settings.

Current State:
- DataFrame adapters have ZERO tuning framework integration
- SQL adapters use UnifiedTuningConfiguration with 13 TuningType options
- DataFrame adapters only accept constructor parameters for basic settings
- No way to load/save DataFrame tuning configs from YAML
- No validation or platform compatibility checking

This TODO implements a parallel tuning system designed for DataFrame semantics.
